## Summary
Lenses checked: correctness, silent-failure, tests, comments.
Fix the home-directory escape before merge because previews can disclose files outside the selected directory. Bound the preview read so large files can be previewed without loading them in full.

## Changes
The pull request adds a helper that returns the first 200 characters of a file under the selected home directory and a helper that returns the path to `settings.toml`. It adds tests for short and long previews, rejection of an absolute path outside home, and the settings path.

## Critical

- app/paths.py:12 — correctness — Enforce home containment before reading previews — A path with a parent-directory component or a symlink inside home can pass the check and open a file outside home. `is_relative_to()` compares path components lexically, while `read_text()` follows the filesystem path. — A caller who controls the preview path can disclose contents of readable text files outside the selected directory. — Fix: Resolve the home directory and candidate before checking containment, then open the resolved candidate.

## Important

- app/paths.py:14 — correctness — Read only the previewed characters — Previewing a readable log larger than the process’s available memory can fail because `read_text()[:200]` loads the entire file before slicing it. — Previewing a large log can exhaust memory and disrupt other file-browsing operations. — Fix: Open the file in text mode and read at most 200 characters.
